# Codex Usage Bar

Free, open-source macOS menu bar app and native WidgetKit widgets for viewing
Codex and Kimi subscription quotas, remaining usage, and reset times.

## Official links

- Chinese website: https://codex.cmmuu.com/
- English website: https://codex.cmmuu.com/en/
- Source: https://github.com/CMMUU/codex-usage-bar
- Download center: https://downloads.cmmuu.com/projects/codex-usage-bar
- Latest universal DMG: https://downloads.cmmuu.com/download/codex-usage-bar/latest/macos-universal
- GitHub backup: https://github.com/CMMUU/codex-usage-bar/releases/latest
- Issues: https://github.com/CMMUU/codex-usage-bar/issues
- License: https://github.com/CMMUU/codex-usage-bar/blob/main/LICENSE

## Facts

- Menu bar app: macOS 13 or later; desktop widgets: macOS 14 or later.
- One universal DMG supports Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
- Languages: Simplified Chinese and English.
- The website shows illustrative data and does not read account credentials.
- The app uses local Codex sign-in or Kimi Code credentials to query each service.
- Available quota windows depend on the account and provider.
- Signed automatic updates are delivered through the download center.
- The app refreshes about every five minutes. macOS schedules widget refreshes.
- The project is independent and unofficial, with no affiliation or endorsement
  from OpenAI or Moonshot AI.
